title: ESA TOPS low-thrust suite (zero-order-hold repository, pinned revision 24fe8849)

selection_rules.easy_two_body: fixed-time Cartesian two-body problem with the smallest tof/mean-period ratio
selection_rules.multi_revolution_two_body: Cartesian two-body problem whose info string declares a multirev arc (lowest key)
selection_rules.inclination_or_eccentricity_change: Cartesian two-body problem whose info string mentions inclination or highly-elliptic (lowest key)
selection_rules.cr3bp: fixed-time CR3BP problem with the smallest tof/mean-period ratio

published.note: the Cartesian two-body JSON entries carry no reference objective; MEE entries carry 'solution_indirect' decision vectors in MEE variables (not used)
